_method: Labelled by eye 2026-08-18 from the SAME method as others/LABELS.json -- edge-dense crops upscaled NEAREST, never a centre crop. Every asset was seen in a 28px edge-dense crop at 7x; the eight genuinely ambiguous ones were re-inspected as THREE non-overlapping 24px crops at 13x before a label was written. Labels describe the file's own EDGE STRUCTURE, which is the only thing a discriminator can see -- not the asset's artistic lineage (see the PixelSaber note). NO measure from the script was consulted while labelling; using one would make any later score circular (references/lessons.md SS23).
_what_this_population_is: 37 background-removed assets: 35 hard-alpha cutouts (<=2 alpha levels) and 2 true soft-alpha PNGs (255 levels). This is the ALREADY-TRANSPARENT population -- the labelled others/ set is 31 fully opaque GIFs and contains nothing of this kind. 4 of these files are the background-removed counterparts of assets already labelled in others/LABELS.json, giving direct before/after pairs.

_notes.PixelSaber-ezgif.com-gif-maker (2).gif: pixel-art LINEAGE (others/Pixel Saber.gif is labelled pixel_art) but this file's own pixels are ramped -- it is an upscaled/re-encoded copy. Labelled by what the pixels ARE, not by artistic origin, because that is all a discriminator can see.

This file is the binding negative for FLAT_PALETTE_MAX_COLORS: at 26 composited colours it is the lowest-colour antialiased asset in all five populations, and it is why that floor sits at 16 rather than the 24 a sweep would have picked.

_reexamined_2026_08_18._what_happened: A new measure (composited colour count) disagreed with these two labels, so both were re-inspected at 12x NEAREST. c33ec49 shows flat blocks with stepped diagonals; the 4x upscale shows block staircases on its outlines. Both readings pull toward pixel_art and AWAY from what is recorded here.
_reexamined_2026_08_18._decision: NEITHER LABEL WAS CHANGED. Both already carried a written lower-confidence reason from the 13x pass -- 'isolated intermediate pixels at the transitions' and 'real 2-3 step ramps on every dark outline' -- and a coarser second look is not grounds to overturn a documented one. Overturning them would also have moved the score of the very measure that raised the question, which is the definition of label-fitting. They are the two lowest-confidence labels in this corpus; the sensitivity is reported instead: flipping both would take the post-fix specificity from 0.986 to 0.993 and recall from 0.939 to 0.937.
